integrity: The proof is symbolic and reconstructed from the definitions and the published Theorem 7 inequality. The publisher PDF was inspected around Theorems 6–7 and Remark 7, including rendered-page inspection of the theorem region. Primary MSC 11A25 was verified. limitations: The theorem concerns the unrestricted composite minimum of \(V(n)/\sigma(n)\), not other level sets or restricted families. The finite replay is regression evidence only. The 2021 paper has no Online First day in its PDF; the day-level public evidence used here is the institutional newsletter interval 17–23 September 2021, and the date field records the interval first date.
